documentation.overview: Argon2 is the winner of the Password Hashing Competition (PHC). It is a modern, cryptographically secure password hashing algorithm designed to resist GPU-based brute-force attacks and side-channel attacks through memory-hard operations.
documentation.purpose: Used to hash passwords before storing them in databases, and securely verify login attempts against stored hashes without exposing plaintext passwords.
documentation.configuration: Configurable options include memoryCost (RAM usage in KiB), timeCost (number of iterations), parallelism (threads), and hashLength.
documentation.security_considerations: Always prefer Argon2id over Argon2i or Argon2d. Argon2id provides balanced defense against both side-channel timing attacks and GPU cracking hardware.
documentation.error_handling: Errors thrown by argon2 include invalid parameter configurations or verification failures due to corrupted hash formats.

symbols.name: argon2.hash
symbols.syntax: argon2.hash(plain: string | Buffer, options?: Options): Promise<string>
symbols.description: Calculates an encoded Argon2id hash string from a plaintext password string or buffer with an automatically generated cryptographically secure salt.

parameters.name: plain
parameters.description: The plaintext password or binary buffer to hash.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional tuning configuration including memoryCost, timeCost, parallelism, saltLength, and type.

symbols.name: argon2.verify
symbols.syntax: argon2.verify(digest: string, plain: string | Buffer, options?: Options): Promise<boolean>
symbols.description: Verifies whether a plaintext password matches an existing encoded Argon2 hash digest.

parameters.name: digest
parameters.description: The previously stored encoded Argon2 hash digest string.

parameters.name: plain
parameters.description: The submitted plaintext password to verify against the hash.

pipelines.name: Password Registration Pipeline
pipelines.description: Step-by-step cryptographic sequence for onboarding user passwords.
pipelines.objective: Receive, salt, hash, and persist user credentials with optimal memory-hard security.

steps.title: Receive password
steps.explanation: Accept raw password from registration input over a secure HTTPS transport. Avoid logging plaintext.

steps.title: Generate random salt
steps.explanation: Argon2 generates a cryptographically secure 16-byte CSPRNG salt automatically if omitted.

steps.title: Hash using Argon2id
steps.explanation: Execute argon2.hash with memoryCost: 65536 (64 MB), timeCost: 3 iterations, and parallelism: 1.

steps.title: Store encoded hash
steps.explanation: Save the resulting encoded string into the database credentials table.

pipelines.name: Password Verification Pipeline
pipelines.description: Step-by-step cryptographic sequence for validating credentials on login.
pipelines.objective: Verify submitted password against stored hash without timing leakage.

steps.title: Receive login password
steps.explanation: Extract submitted credentials from authentication request payload.

steps.title: Retrieve stored hash
steps.explanation: Query the user account in the database and retrieve the stored Argon2 hash digest.

steps.title: Verify password
steps.explanation: Call argon2.verify(storedHash, submittedPassword) using constant-time comparison.

steps.title: Return authentication result
steps.explanation: If valid, issue session token or JWT; if invalid, return generic authentication failure.
